p2g1.instruction: Complete the table below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passages for each answer.
p2g1.body: Name of plastic, Date of invention, Original region, Property, and Common use table. Celluloid: Date of invention 1860s, Original region US, Common use '[[14]]'. [[15]]: Date of invention 1907, Original region US, Property 'Can be cast and moulded but cannot be softened by heat', Common use '[[16]]; household items and car parts'. Polythene: Date of invention 1930, Original region '[[17]]', Common use 'Bottles'. Rigid PVC: Property '[[18]]'. Polystyrene: Date of invention 1930s, Original region Germany, Property '[[19]]', Common use 'Food container'. Polyurethanes: Original region Germany, Property '[[20]] foams', Common use 'Adhesives, coatings and insulation'.
